question: How many models are in the bank's model inventory?
paraphrases: How many models does the bank have?
cypher: MATCH (m:Model) RETURN count(m) AS models

question: How many models are there in each risk tier?
paraphrases: Break the model inventory down by tier.
cypher: MATCH (m:Model) RETURN m.tier AS tier, count(m) AS models ORDER BY tier

question: How many models are in production, in development, and retired?
paraphrases: Count the models by lifecycle status.
cypher: MATCH (m:Model) RETURN m.status AS status, count(m) AS models ORDER BY models DESC

question: How many {category} models are in the inventory?
cypher: MATCH (m:Model {category: $category}) RETURN count(m) AS models

question: Which regulatory frameworks are recorded in the graph?
paraphrases: List the regulations the model-risk graph tracks.
cypher: MATCH (r:RegulatoryRequirement) RETURN DISTINCT r.framework AS framework

question: Which model input features contain personally identifiable information?
paraphrases: Which features are flagged as PII?
cypher: MATCH (f:Feature) WHERE f.pii = 1 RETURN f.name AS feature

question: Which data sources are classified as {sensitivity}?
cypher: MATCH (d:DataSource {sensitivity: $sensitivity}) RETURN d.name AS data_source

question: When is the {submission} submission next due, and which regulator receives it?
cypher: MATCH (s:Submission {name: $submission}) RETURN s.next_due AS next_due, s.regulator AS regulator

question: How many validation findings are open, closed, and overdue?
paraphrases: Count the validation findings by status.
cypher: MATCH (f:ValidationFinding) RETURN f.status AS status, count(f) AS findings ORDER BY findings DESC

question: Which modelling assumptions are marked as stale or breached?
paraphrases: Which assumptions are no longer valid?
cypher: MATCH (a:Assumption) WHERE a.status IN ['Stale', 'Breached'] RETURN a.description AS assumption, a.status AS status

question: Who holds the role of {role}?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person {role: $role}) RETURN p.name AS person

question: How many models are flagged as having no regulatory use?
cypher: MATCH (m:Model) WHERE m.regulatory_use = 0 RETURN count(m) AS models

question: Who owns the model {model}?
cypher: MATCH (m:Model {name: $model})-[:OWNED_BY]->(p:Person) RETURN p.name AS owner, p.role AS role

question: Which model controls are rated {status}?
cypher: MATCH (c:Control {status: $status}) RETURN c.name AS control

question: How many models does each business unit own?
paraphrases: Break the model inventory down by business unit.
cypher: MATCH (m:Model)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(b:BusinessUnit) RETURN b.name AS business_unit, count(m) AS models ORDER BY models DESC, business_unit

question: Which production models belong to the {business_unit} business unit?
cypher: MATCH (m:Model {status: 'Production'})-[:BELONGS_TO]->(:BusinessUnit {name: $business_unit}) RETURN m.name AS model

question: How many high-severity findings are still open or overdue?
paraphrases: How many unresolved high-severity validation findings are there?
cypher: MATCH (f:ValidationFinding {severity: 'High'}) WHERE f.status IN ['Open', 'Overdue'] RETURN count(f) AS findings

question: Which input features does the model {model} use?
cypher: MATCH (:Model {name: $model})-[:USES_FEATURE]->(f:Feature) RETURN f.name AS feature

question: Which data source is the feature {feature} derived from?
cypher: MATCH (:Feature {name: $feature})-[:DERIVED_FROM]->(d:DataSource) RETURN d.name AS data_source, d.system AS system

question: How many models are governed by {framework}?
cypher: MATCH (m:Model)-[:GOVERNED_BY]->(:RegulatoryRequirement {framework: $framework}) RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS models

question: Which controls help satisfy {framework} requirements?
cypher: MATCH (c:Control)-[:SATISFIES]->(:RegulatoryRequirement {framework: $framework}) RETURN DISTINCT c.name AS control

question: How many models feed directly into the {submission} submission?
cypher: MATCH (m:Model)-[:FEEDS]->(:Submission {name: $submission}) RETURN count(m) AS models

question: How many models support each business decision?
paraphrases: Which business decisions rely on the most models?
cypher: MATCH (m:Model)-[:USED_IN]->(d:Decision) RETURN d.name AS decision, count(m) AS models ORDER BY models DESC, decision

question: Which two people have performed the most model validations?
cypher: MATCH (v:Validation)-[:PERFORMED_BY]->(p:Person) RETURN p.name AS validator, count(v) AS validations ORDER BY validations DESC, validator LIMIT 2

question: Which category of finding has the most findings with status Open?
cypher: MATCH (f:ValidationFinding {status: 'Open'}) RETURN f.category AS category, count(f) AS findings ORDER BY findings DESC, category LIMIT 1

question: Who owns the most tier-1 models?
cypher: MATCH (m:Model {tier: 1})-[:OWNED_BY]->(p:Person) RETURN p.name AS owner, count(m) AS tier1_models ORDER BY tier1_models DESC, owner LIMIT 1

question: Which models did {developer} develop?
cypher: MATCH (m:Model)-[:DEVELOPED_BY]->(:Person {name: $developer}) RETURN m.name AS model

question: Which production models have failed at least one validation?
cypher: MATCH (m:Model {status: 'Production'})-[:VALIDATED_BY]->(v:Validation {outcome: 'Fail'}) RETURN DISTINCT m.name AS model

question: Which models have never been validated?
paraphrases: Which models have no validation on record?
cypher: MATCH (m:Model) WHERE NOT (m)-[:VALIDATED_BY]->(:Validation) RETURN m.name AS model

question: Which three data sources do the most models depend on?
paraphrases: What are the bank's biggest data concentration points?
cypher: MATCH (m:Model)-[:DEPENDS_ON]->(d:DataSource) RETURN d.name AS data_source, count(m) AS models ORDER BY models DESC, data_source LIMIT 3

question: For how many validated models does the recorded last-validated date differ from the date of their most recent validation?
cypher: MATCH (m:Model)-[:VALIDATED_BY]->(v:Validation) WITH m, max(v.date) AS latest WHERE m.last_validated <> latest RETURN count(m) AS models

question: How many validations were carried out in each year?
cypher: MATCH (v:Validation) RETURN substring(v.date, 0, 4) AS year, count(v) AS validations ORDER BY year

question: Show the validation history of {model}: date, type and outcome, oldest first.
cypher: MATCH (:Model {name: $model})-[:VALIDATED_BY]->(v:Validation) RETURN v.date AS date, v.type AS type, v.outcome AS outcome ORDER BY date

question: Which models feed their outputs into {model}?
cypher: MATCH (u:Model)-[:FEEDS]->(:Model {name: $model}) RETURN u.name AS upstream_model

question: Which regulatory requirement does not govern any model?
cypher: MATCH (r:RegulatoryRequirement) WHERE NOT (:Model)-[:GOVERNED_BY]->(r) RETURN r.framework AS framework, r.clause AS clause, r.title AS title

question: Who works in the {business_unit} business unit, and in what role?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(:BusinessUnit {name: $business_unit}) RETURN p.name AS person, p.role AS role

question: How many distinct models contribute to the {submission} submission, either directly or by feeding another model that does?
cypher: MATCH (m:Model)-[:FEEDS*1..2]->(:Submission {name: $submission}) RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS models

question: If the {data_source} changed, which regulatory submissions would be affected, and through how many dependent models each?
cypher: MATCH (:DataSource {name: $data_source})<-[:DEPENDS_ON]-(m:Model)-[:FEEDS]->(s:Submission) RETURN s.name AS submission, count(DISTINCT m) AS models ORDER BY models DESC, submission

question: How many open or overdue high-severity findings does each business unit carry across its models?
cypher: MATCH (b:BusinessUnit)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(m:Model)-[:VALIDATED_BY]->(:Validation)-[:RAISED]->(f:ValidationFinding {severity: 'High'}) WHERE f.status IN ['Open', 'Overdue'] RETURN b.name AS business_unit, count(f) AS findings ORDER BY findings DESC, business_unit

question: How many open or overdue findings sit on models owned by {owner}?
cypher: MATCH (:Person {name: $owner})<-[:OWNED_BY]-(m:Model)-[:VALIDATED_BY]->(:Validation)-[:RAISED]->(f:ValidationFinding) WHERE f.status IN ['Open', 'Overdue'] RETURN count(f) AS findings

question: Which business decisions are made by models that use a feature derived from the {data_source}?
cypher: MATCH (:DataSource {name: $data_source})<-[:DERIVED_FROM]-(:Feature)<-[:USES_FEATURE]-(m:Model)-[:USED_IN]->(d:Decision) RETURN DISTINCT d.name AS decision

question: How many validations provide evidence for controls that satisfy {framework} requirements?
cypher: MATCH (v:Validation)-[:EVIDENCES]->(:Control)-[:SATISFIES]->(:RegulatoryRequirement {framework: $framework}) RETURN count(DISTINCT v) AS validations

question: Which production models that feed directly into {submission} have failed a validation?
cypher: MATCH (v:Validation {outcome: 'Fail'})<-[:VALIDATED_BY]-(m:Model {status: 'Production'})-[:FEEDS]->(:Submission {name: $submission}) RETURN DISTINCT m.name AS model

question: How many model-to-model feeds cross from one business unit to another?
cypher: MATCH (b1:BusinessUnit)<-[:BELONGS_TO]-(a:Model)-[:FEEDS]->(c:Model)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(b2:BusinessUnit) WHERE b1 <> b2 RETURN count(*) AS cross_unit_feeds

question: How many validations were performed by a colleague of the model's owner, someone other than the owner who works in the same business unit?
cypher: MATCH (val:Person)<-[:PERFORMED_BY]-(v:Validation)<-[:VALIDATED_BY]-(m:Model)-[:OWNED_BY]->(o:Person) WHERE val <> o MATCH (val)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(b:BusinessUnit), (o)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(b) RETURN count(DISTINCT v) AS validations

question: Which models were validated by their own owner, and by whom?
paraphrases: Where did a model owner validate their own model?
cypher: MATCH (p:Person)<-[:PERFORMED_BY]-(v:Validation)<-[:VALIDATED_BY]-(m:Model)-[:OWNED_BY]->(p) RETURN m.name AS model, p.name AS owner, count(v) AS validations

question: How many production models use at least one personal-data feature but are not governed by the EU AI Act transparency requirement (Art.13)?
cypher: MATCH (m:Model {status: 'Production'})-[:USES_FEATURE]->(:Feature {pii: 1}) WHERE NOT (m)-[:GOVERNED_BY]->(:RegulatoryRequirement {framework: 'EU AI Act', clause: 'Art.13'}) RETURN count(DISTINCT m) AS models

question: What is the AUC of each credit scorecard model?
cypher: MATCH (m:Model {category: 'Credit Scorecard'}) WHERE m.auc IS NOT NULL RETURN m.name AS model, m.auc AS auc

question: By what date must each overdue finding be remediated?
cypher: MATCH (f:ValidationFinding {status: 'Overdue'}) WHERE f.due_date IS NOT NULL RETURN f.title AS finding, f.due_date AS due_date

question: How much did the validations of {model} cost?
cypher: MATCH (:Model {name: $model})-[:VALIDATED_BY]->(v:Validation) WHERE v.cost IS NOT NULL RETURN v.date AS date, v.cost AS cost

question: Which business unit's models carry the largest risk-weighted-asset charge?
cypher: MATCH (m:Model)-[:BELONGS_TO]->(b:BusinessUnit) WHERE m.rwa IS NOT NULL RETURN b.name AS business_unit, sum(m.rwa) AS rwa ORDER BY rwa DESC, business_unit LIMIT 1
